summary: KIDZ AI Inc. (formerly Classover Holdings) filed an 8-K reporting an additional closing under its May 30, 2025 Securities Purchase Agreement with Solana Growth Ventures LLC. On September 17, 2026, the company issued and sold a senior secured convertible note with a $1.9 million original principal amount for an aggregate funding amount of $1.9 million, less placement agent fees and offering expenses. The note bears 7% interest per annum, matures September 17, 2028, and converts at an initial price of $3.672 per Class B common share. It ranks senior to existing and future indebtedness and is secured by a first-priority perfected security interest. The issuance was made under Section 4(a)(2) exemption. Watch for potential dilution and conversion-related overhang.
